findings.evidence: When you use Bing and MSN services with a web browser, we will place one or more 'cookies' on your machine. For example, Bing uses a cookie with a unique identifier known as the Search ID to operate the service and enable certain search features.
When you use Bing and MSN services, Microsoft may collect many kinds of information in order to operate effectively and provide you the best products, services and experiences we can.
We also use web beacons to help deliver cookies and compile analytics. These may include third-party web beacons, which are prohibited from collecting your personal information.
